content: Joy is uncaused. You are joyful just because you are.
author: Osho
sourceWork: Freedom: The Courage to Be Yourself
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. True wisdom is rarely complicated or flashy, but it demands the honesty to look at our own habits and assumptions without defensive excuses.

Osho understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. When you stop looking for external validation and anchor your self-worth in quiet integrity, the noisy chaos of the world loses its power over you. A good life is built day by day through small, conscious choices.
reflectionPrompt: What mental clutter or unrealistic expectation can you let go of to make room for simple joy?
